scope: Eight reserved passes represented by seven certificate sections; five targets and three additional probes remain scoped, not a complete TOE

11361_ray_CP_bridge.scope: Exact algebraic ray-to-full-rank Gram construction, not a dynamical or observed CKM prediction
11361_ray_CP_bridge.identity: Tr([A,B]^3)/i=-6 det(G) ImTr(P1P2P3) c12 c13 c23; c_ij=a_i b_j-a_j b_i
11361_ray_CP_bridge.proof: A=X diag(a) Xdag, B=X diag(b) Xdag. Set K=diag(a)Gdiag(b)-diag(b)Gdiag(a). Then [A,B]=X K Xdag, det[A,B]=det(G)det(K), det(K)=-2i c12 c13 c23 Im(G12 G23 G31), and Tr([A,B]^3)=3det[A,B].
11361_ray_CP_bridge.nonzero_criterion: The cubic is nonzero exactly when the three rays span C3, their Bargmann loop has nonzero imaginary part, and all three pairwise weight minors are nonzero.
11361_ray_CP_bridge.boundary: The rays are prior-owned; the positive weights are supplied. Their conjugate orientation reverses J at equal CP-even energy. No W33 dynamics selects these weights, orientation, masses or observed mixing.

11362_invariant_hard_radial_loop.scope: One specified invariant heavy-scalar 1PI normal contribution, not the 105-entry native E6 hard block
11362_invariant_hard_radial_loop.invariant: I=phi^dag phi; mS^2=M^2+g(I-I0), one real spectator; mu^2=M^2/e
11362_invariant_hard_radial_loop.normal_Hessian: Hloop=g^2 v v^T/(32pi^2), v=dI/dx, ||v||^2=2; one nonzero eigenvalue g^2/(16pi^2)
11362_invariant_hard_radial_loop.boundary: The heavy field and g are supplied. This computes one scheme-dependent normal direction and proves Ward columns do not fix it; it is not native UV matching or a mass prediction.

11363_11364_exact_metric_cycle_rank.scope: Exact rank theorem for the named native pair-metric cycle model, not the preferred multivielbein Dirac algebra
11363_11364_exact_metric_cycle_rank.hidden_equal_lapse_null: eta; because (U^T eta)_e(B^T eta)_e=(B^T eta^2)_e and C^T B^T=0
11363_11364_exact_metric_cycle_rank.generic_nulls: N and point/line checkerboard; both exact
11363_11364_exact_metric_cycle_rank.stationary_construction: L=U^T N>0, r=B^T eta, j=(r/L)/sqrt(1-(r/L)^2), p=Bj. The cycle stationarity is exact and A=C^T diag(L/(1+j^2)^(3/2)) C>0. Thus H_lapse=-G A^-1 G^T has rank78 at this point; a nonzero rational minor makes this rank generic in the algebraic family.
11363_11364_exact_metric_cycle_rank.boundary: Rank78 is a ghost-constraint obstruction for the named pair-metric cycle action. It does not prove a full Dirac count, nor refute the distinct vertex-frame multivielbein action.

11365_wound_wall_spectrum.scope: Exact odd mixed zero and converged Ritz trial-space values at zero bare rho; no full wall stability claim
11365_wound_wall_spectrum.boundary: Ritz eigenvalues are upper bounds within a restricted odd m=0 Schur block and cannot exclude negative modes in the full breathing, wall-bending, axion or tensor sectors.

11366_wall_family_scale.scope: Exact one-parameter supplied winding-wall family and bare-rho uniqueness, not observed vacuum-energy selection
11366_wall_family_scale.scale_boundary: The dimensionless solution fixes neither the physical length L nor mass units: curvature scales as L^-2 and vacuum-energy density as L^-4. Bare rho=0 still has strictly positive Ricci scalar from axion stress.

11367_transverse_octagon_holonomy.scope: Exact noncommuting transverse-boost holonomy on a native octagon; necessary flatness condition, not full Dirac closure
11367_transverse_octagon_holonomy.vertex_frame_flatness: For edge transports Lambda_i^-1 Lambda_j, ordered product on every closed graph cycle is exactly I. Independent transverse edge boosts with the displayed octagon product therefore cannot come from vertex frames without compensating rotations.
11367_transverse_octagon_holonomy.boundary: This rules out independent-edge transverse boost assignments in a vertex-frame construction. It neither counts secondary constraints nor proves generic multivielbein ghost freedom.

11368_legacy_claim_scope.scope: Source-level claim audit, not a physical parameter fit
11368_legacy_claim_scope.conflict: The legacy site labelled dimensionless integer coincidences in GeV and log10(CC/MPl^4)=-127 as exact predictions; its own arithmetic gives 40*3+4-2=122. The current paper and Pass 11348 leave mass/CC scale dynamics open.
11368_legacy_claim_scope.resolution: The legacy catalogue now calls these arithmetic correspondences, corrects 127 to 122, and states that GeV and vacuum-energy identifications require missing dynamics.
11368_legacy_claim_scope.boundary: No observed mass, Higgs VEV, or vacuum energy is derived by the corrected wording.
